name: io.github.stephenpham68/suber-agent-team
title: Suber Agent Team
description: Offload Claude Code sub-agents to a cheap model (Haiku / any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible API) - run 20-100 parallel agents for fan-out, map-reduce & research without draining your Opus / Claude Max quota.

environmentVariables.name: SUBER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your cheap provider (Anthropic- or OpenAI-compatible), e.g. https://api.anthropic.com

environmentVariables.name: SUBER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the cheap fleet provider (NOT your main account).

environmentVariables.name: SUBER_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Cheap model id the worker fleet runs on, e.g. claude-haiku-4-5 or deepseek-chat.

environmentVariables.name: SUBER_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Wire format: 'anthropic' (Messages API) or 'openai' (Chat Completions). Default: anthropic.

environmentVariables.name: SUBER_PRESET
environmentVariables.description: Optional baked-in preset: orbit-anthropic | orbit-openai | orbit-tiered.
